_about.weapons: the game's weapon tables (build_weapons.py; the MH4U Collection Tracker's decode): melee [0xf5884c + 4 * item type] 0x18-byte records, gunners [0xf58884 + 4 * item type] 0x28 bytes. `model` = record +0 u16 (every record's model is on the cart but one, the getter is not traced); `pig` = the pigment index (READ 0x2f854c: melee record +0x12 into pigments.melee, gunner +0x1b into pigments.gunner); names LMD <Class>Name at the record index. Record 0 and DUMMY rows are out.
_about.classes: `cls` = the class byte [0xf5f2fc + item type] (READ 0x2f13b4), the wNN of the motion lists; `name` = Common message 36 + item type; `parts` = the loader's part names [0xfb8984 + 4 * cls]. The Insect Glaive's second part, mus, is the Kinsect, from its own folder.
_about.kinsects: LMD InsectName; `model` = u16 [0xf58a02 + 14 * id] (READ 0x2f52a8). A glaive with `kinsect` forces that model (glaive ids 0x26, 0x85, 0x86 in the same function).
_about.models: every weapon model on the cart, with the armour's 3DS fixes; keyed <dir>/<part><model>.
